title: How to maintain an AC unit?
desc: Clean or replace the air filter regularly, keep the unit free of debris, and schedule professional servicing twice a year for optimal AC performance. – By Umair, Technician of FAJ

title: What does an AC service include?
desc: An AC service typically includes inspecting and cleaning the system, replacing filters, checking refrigerant levels, inspecting electrical components, and ensuring the unit is operating efficiently. -  By Mr Malik, Engineer of FAJ.

title: Is AC system cleaning necessary?
desc: Yes, AC system cleaning is necessary for optimal performance. FAJ Experts recommend regularly cleaning or replacing filters to improve airflow, system efficiency, and overall longevity.

title: What is the most common AC repair?
desc: The most common AC repair is refrigerant recharge or leak repair, as low refrigerant affects cooling efficiency. Other common issues include capacitor failures, clogged drain lines, dirty filters, frozen coils, faulty fan motors, and thermostat malfunctions. – Mr. Malik, Engineer at FAJ

title: What are some efficient commercial air conditioner repair services in Dubai?
desc: Efficient commercial AC repair services in Dubai include a team of experienced engineers offering installation, preventive maintenance, and emergency services for both residential and commercial spaces. – Umair, Technician at FAJ
